This section summarizes variables output from the model in a format
that is easy to search and print.
The model variables are grouped together in common categories and are
available in both the dictionaries of steady-state and transition-path
output, unless noted otherwise in these docs.
Assets of the funded defined contribution fund (individual account holdings)
Spread the funded defined contribution fund earns on the balances it owes (r_fdc_wedge times the owed balances)
Reserve of the funded defined contribution fund at the beginning of the period (temporary: zero from tG1 on and in the steady state)
FDC fund revenue paid by the funded defined contribution fund to the government (not tax revenue)
Transfer from the government to the funded defined contribution fund covering a negative spread or reserve deficit
Aggregate capital stock owned by foreign investors
Aggregate capital stock owned by domestic investors
Aggregate investment, not account for immigrant investment
Total tax revenue from personal income and payroll taxes
Total tax revenue from personal income taxes
Total tax revenue from payroll taxes (i.e., social security contributions)
Total tax revenue from taxes on bequests
Total tax revenue from wealth taxes
Total tax revenue from consumption taxes
Total government debt held by foreign investors
Total government debt held by domestic investors
New government borrowing, equal to budget deficit
Total interest payments on government debt
New government borrowing from foreign investors
Government debt interest payments made to foreign investors
Real rate of return on private capital per model period.
Real rate of return on government debt per model period.
Real rate of return on household investment portfolio per model period.
Wage rate per effective labor hour
